SECURITYAGREEMENT AND FIXTURE FILING
This Mortgage and Consolidated, Amended and Restated Mortgage, Assignment of Rents
and Leases, Security Agreement and Fixture Filing (this “Mortgage") is executed as of
December 23, 2019, by COLUMBUS MANOR LLC, a Delaware limited liability company
(“Columbus Borrower") and WESTwooD HOUSE LLC, a Delaware limited liability
“Mortgagor" and collectively, jointly and severally, as the context may require, the
“Mortgagor"), having an office at 156 William Street, 10th Floor, New York, New York 10038,
for the benefit of LANDESBANK HESSEN-THÜRINGEN GIROZENTRALE, having an
office at 420 Fifth Avenue, 24th Floor, New York, New York 10018-2729, as agent for the Banks
described in the Loan Agreement, as hereinafter described (“Mortgagee").
RECITALS:
A.
Mortgagor is the owner of a fee estate in that certain real property described in
Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Premises").
B.Mortgagor is indebted to Capital One, National Association (hereinafter referred
to as the "Pavee"), which indebtedness is secured by those certain mortgages described in
Schedule 1 and covering all or part of the property hereinbefore described, on which there is
now owing the aggregate principal sum of $79,586,625.1l (collectively, the “Payee Mortgage"),
as evidenced by notes in the original principal aggregate amount of $80,000,000.00 (the “Payee
Note").
C.The Payee has, by assignment dated as of the date hereof assigned the Payee
Mortgage and the Payee Note to Mortgagee, which assignment is intended to be recorded
simultaneously herewith in the Office of the New York City Register, New York County.
D.Mortgagor has requested that Mortgagee, and Mortgagee has agreed to, loan an
additional amount of $5,913,374.89 to Mortgagor, to be evidenced by that certain Gap
Promissory Note executed by Mortgagor dated as of the date hereof (as the same may be issued,
supplemented, amended, restated, renewed, replaced, substituted, modified or extended from
time to time, the “Gap Note" and together with the Payee Note, the “Prior Notes") which Prior
Notes are being superseded and replaced in their entirety by that certain Consolidated, Amended
and Restated Promissory Note in the aggregate principal amount of $85,500,000.00 executed by
Mortgagor dated as of the date hereof (as the same may be issued, supplemented, amended,
restated, renewed, replaced, substituted, modified or extended from time to time, the “Note"),
which Note evidences the loan being made to Mortgagor pursuant to that certain Term Loan
Agreement dated as of the date hereof by and among Mortgagor, Mortgagee and the Banks (the
"Loan Agreement").
E.
The Payee Mortgage is being amended, modified and restated in its entirety and
superseded and replaced by this Mortgage.
